title: Optimal fully dynamic matching on the line
abstract: Constructs a measurable hierarchical policy for fully dynamic matching of uniformly arriving demand and replenishment on the unit interval. Proves logarithmic-over-inventory bounds for long-run root-mean-square distance from every initial inventory and for initialized finite-horizon expected average cost.

informal.FD1D.V5.Palomar.optimalDynamicMatchingUp: For every inventory size m at least two, an online policy has long-run RMS cost at most (72000/log 2) log(m+1)/m from every initial inventory, and the same expected-average-cost bound after initialization for horizons at least 2m².
